tender_title: SIGHT Scheme Tranche-I (Mode 1: Green H2 Production)
scope_and_awarded_bidders: 412,000 t/yr awarded in Bucket I (Technology Agnostic) + 2,000 t/yr in Bucket II (Biomass). Official winning bids: Reliance (90k tpa @ INR 18.90/kg), Welspun (20k tpa @ INR 20.00/kg), HHP Two/Hygenco (75.13k tpa @ INR 25.04/kg), Torrent Power (18k tpa @ INR 28.89/kg), ACME (90k tpa @ INR 30.00/kg), Greenko (90k tpa @ INR 30.00/kg), Green Infra/Sembcorp (36k tpa @ INR 34.00/kg), JSW Neo Energy (6.5k tpa @ INR 34.66/kg), UPL (10.1k tpa @ INR 0.00/kg zero-incentive), BPCL (2k tpa Bucket II @ INR 34.50/kg)
headline_tariff_or_incentive: Direct 3-year production subsidy: INR 0.00 - 34.66 / kg H2 (Year 1 cap INR 50/kg, Yr 2 INR 40/kg, Yr 3 INR 30/kg)
subsidized_or_net_effective_cost: Capacity-weighted average requested subsidy: ~INR 26.20 / kg H2 during first 3 years of commercial production
tender_date_and_rfp: RfS: SECI/C&P/IPP/11/2023/SIGHT/P1; Bids opened Jan 2024, LoAs issued Jan-Mar 2024; official allocation sheet published by SECI
source_documentation_and_links: SECI Notification of Selection F.No. SECI/C&P/IPP/11/2023/SIGHT/P1/LoA (Jan 2024); PIB Delhi Press Release 09 Jan 2024
regulatory_context: National Green Hydrogen Mission initial commercial production allocation round

tender_title: Panipat Refinery 10 KTA Green Hydrogen Project (Build-Own-Operate)
